description.en: The ID of the router interface.

description.zh:
路由器接口所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The ID of the region to which the router interface belongs.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc describe-router-interface-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id ri-m5egfc10sednwk2yt0000 --region cn-hangzhou
